_comment: Ultraphonics campaign link registry. Run: node scripts/utm-architect.mjs check-all
_issues_key: needs_rebuild = update tiny.cc destination URL to fix; ga4_trackable = false means GA4 gets no data

links.name: Ultrasheet (Google Sheets)
links._note: Destination is Google Docs — GA4 cannot track a page_view there. No UTM params needed. Excluded from check-all.

links.name: 2026 Survey Post (Facebook)
links._note: www. prefix will cause GA4 hostname fragmentation. Rebuild destination with ultraphonicsmusic.com (no www). Also consider renaming to campaign=fan_engagement&content=2026_survey.

links.name: 24K Magic YouTube Video
links._note: Song name + date in utm_campaign creates a new GA4 campaign for every video. Rebuild as campaign=youtube_content&content=24k_magic so all YouTube videos roll up into one campaign.

links.name: Facebook Cover Photo
links._note: www. prefix issue. Also consider renaming to campaign=profile_optimization&content=cover_photo for consistency.

links.name: Weddings Facebook Post
links._note: www. prefix issue. Campaign name 'weddings' conflicts with 'weddings_flyer' (offline) — same objective, split GA4 data. Rebuild as campaign=wedding_booking&content=fb_post.

links.name: Book Us CTA (Facebook)
links._note: www. prefix issue. Campaign name is too verbose and a sentence — will be truncated in GA4 UI. Same objective as 'weddings' and 'weddings_flyer'. Rebuild as campaign=wedding_booking&content=book_us_cta.
